**Monday – Aim of the day: Olympic lifting and heavy pulling. Squat clean singles up to 90% in Athlete Comp, heavier 5s in Building, faster intervals in Cardio.**

**ON THEIR OWN**
- **RT Movement – functional fitness class (~60 min):** Power snatch + overhead squat 6x(2+2) up to 80%, then 3 rounds of wall balls, pull-ups and bike (14:00 cap). *Attack it:* heaviest complex so far, then wall balls in 2 sets every round.
- **Athlete Comp (~65 min):** Squat clean 3-2-2-1-1-1 up to 90%, front squat 4x2 @ 80%, then 21-15-9 power cleans, chest-to-bar and Echo bike. *Attack it:* fast elbows on the singles, short sets in the workout.
- **Body Box Building (~65 min):** Strict press 5x5, Pendlay row 5x5, weighted dips 4x8, single arm DB rows 4x12/12, core. *Attack it:* heavier than last week's 6s.
- **Cardio (~60 min):** 1600m run, 5 x 1:30 at 5k pace, 4 x 1:00 at 3k pace, 1 mile run. *Attack it:* same pace on every rep.
- **S.H.I.I.T (~47 min):** Day B: floor cardio, push/pull rounds, plyo push-ups + DB snatches, 3 min of DB devil press, anti-rotation core.
- **Mobility & Stretch:** Overhead and lats.

**PUT TOGETHER**
- **Athlete Comp + Body Box Building (~2 hr 10):** Good pair. Cleans first, then press and rows.
- **Athlete Comp + Body Box Building + Cardio (~3 hr 10):** Full day. Lift first, and do the intervals on a machine if your legs are done.
- **Cardio + Body Box Building (~2 hr 5):** Good combo. Lift first, then run.
- **RT Movement + Body Box Building (~2 hr):** OK. Go lighter on the rows if your grip is gone.
- **RT Movement + Athlete Comp:** Not today. Snatches, cleans, pull-ups and chest-to-bar is too much pulling for one day.

**Tuesday – Aim of the day: upper body strength and gymnastics in Athlete Comp, legs in Building, easy miles in Cardio.**

**ON THEIR OWN**
- **RT Movement – functional fitness class (~60 min):** Team of 2, 4 x 9:00 tag-team blocks: machine + American swings, DB push press, burpees over the DB, toes-to-bar. *Attack it:* fast tags, machine back to 0, go.
- **Athlete Comp (~70 min):** Ring dips, weighted pull-ups 5x3, strict toes-to-bar 4x8 with a pause, a 3-round :40/:20 gymnastics EMOM, then hex bar farmer carries. *Attack it:* beat last week's EMOM total.
- **Body Box Building (~60 min):** Back squat 4x5, RDL 4x5, DB step-ups 10/10, banded pull-throughs, core. *Attack it:* heavier than last week's 6s.
- **Cardio (~60 min):** Miles Up, 40 min easy. Goal: 3+ miles.
- **S.H.I.I.T (~47 min):** Station Workout 2: upper push / pull.
- **Toning:** Glutes & legs (Week 5, new moves).

**PUT TOGETHER**
- **Athlete Comp + Body Box Building (~2 hr 10):** Good pair. Upper body in Comp, legs in Building.
- **Athlete Comp + Cardio (~2 hr 10):** Good. Keep the run easy.
- **Athlete Comp + Body Box Building + Cardio (~3 hr 10):** OK. Run truly easy.
- **RT Movement + Body Box Building (~2 hr):** Good. Class is upper body and engine, Building is legs.
- **RT Movement + Athlete Comp:** Not today. Toes-to-bar and pulling in both.

**Wednesday – Aim of the day: jumping and snatching in Athlete Comp, chest and back in Building, machine and DB intervals in Cardio.**

**ON THEIR OWN**
- **RT Movement – functional fitness class (~60 min):** Tempo back squat 5x5 + Pendlay rows, then a 12 min AMRAP of devil press, pull-ups and double-unders. *Attack it:* hold every pause, then win time on the rope.
- **Athlete Comp (~70 min):** Depth jumps and lateral hops, hang squat snatch 6x2 up to 78%, snatch pulls 4x3 @ 95%, split squats 7/7, then 3 x 4 min AMRAP of burpee box jump-overs and double-unders. *Attack it:* quick burpees to earn rope time.
- **Body Box Building (~70 min):** Incline bench 5-5-5-5-10, seal rows, chest flys, straight-arm pulldowns, rear delts, Pallof press, then 5 rounds of sled push + drag.
- **Cardio (~55 min):** 4 x 400m row, DB step-overs + shoulder to overhead, 4 x 1000m bike erg, sit-ups + wall balls.
- **S.H.I.I.T (~47 min):** Day C: fast feet, full-body strength-endurance, lateral + rotational power, 3 min lunge to press, core.
- **Mobility & Stretch:** Hips, ankles and calves.

**PUT TOGETHER**
- **Athlete Comp + Body Box Building (~2 hr 20):** Good. Snatch first, then upper body.
- **Athlete Comp + Cardio (~2 hr 5):** OK. Easy on the step-overs.
- **RT Movement + Body Box Building (~2 hr):** OK. Pendlay rows in class, so go lighter on the seal rows.
- **RT Movement + Athlete Comp:** Not today. Squats, jumps and double-unders in both.

**ON THEIR OWN**

- **Athlete Comp (~70 min):** Back squat 3-2-2-2-1 to 90%, split jerk 5x2 to 85%, DB rows + strict HSPU 3x12, then a 15 min AMRAP of bike, bar muscle-ups and sled push. *Attack it:* brace hard on the single, then a pace you can hold for 15.

- **Cardio (~50 min):** Tempo 3 x 12 min, comfortably hard.

- **Mobility & Stretch:** Hamstrings, low back and chest.

- **Body Box Building + Cardio (~1 hr 50):** Good.
- **RT Movement + Cardio (~1 hr 50):** Good.
